decisions.reason: SOL drops 강기 to generic “force”; BASE keeps blade force and the upward spring of 솟구치는 목들.
“Planted a foot” better captures launching off the collapsing ogre; dropping “touching” does not change 목덜미에 닿는 햇볕.
SOL adds unsupported “we” and flattens the clipped 때는/장소는 caption.
BASE’s “spearhead in it” is awkward; SOL adds unsupported “etched” and drops 한가운데에.
decisions.replacement: With the sun at my back, my shadow fell across the midst of the thousand or so monsters gathered below—even the spearhead slashing downward as I dove.

decisions.reason: “Raked the earth” is tighter and still matches 지상을 할퀴었다.
SOL turns 하늘이 쪼개지는 듯한 into a literal split and adds “deafening.”
The whirlwind 칼날이 되어 becomes a blade; SOL weakens that to a simile and slightly intensifies 열풍.
SOL loses POV 시야 and misreads 투두둑 as “heavy drops” instead of rapid splatters.
SOL drops 가볍게, adds unsupported “remaining,” and flattens 멍한 얼굴로.
“Pouring internal energy into my voice” is more idiomatic for 공력을 실은 외침 than “behind my voice.”
SOL loses 어느새; BASE’s “descended on… by then” is stiff for 들이닥친/덮쳤다.
decisions.replacement: With an earsplitting roar, more than a thousand Hunters who had rushed in before I knew it crashed over the monster army like a wave.

decisions.reason: 콰드드드득 is an extended crunch; SOL’s single “Crunch!” flattens the repeated beat.
“Over” and “done” are interchangeable for 끝났으니; no gain.
“Appeared to be the boss” is more precise for 보스 몬스터로 보이는 than “looked like.”
Keep the live present oath 맹세컨대; BASE’s “had not a shred” is stiff, SOL’s past “swore” deadens it.
decisions.replacement: I swear to heaven, I didn’t have the slightest ulterior motive.

decisions.reason: “……” is a narrator beat after the oath, not spoken dialogue.
“Thinking it over” captures 곰곰이 생각해 보니까 more naturally than “after thinking about it.”
속셈 is “scheme,” but SOL’s “couldn’t hide” changes 숨기지 않았지 from choice to inability.
decisions.replacement: “Insidious human. Your scheme to claim the byproducts is plain to see. You didn’t hide your greed even while slaughtering my legion!”

decisions.reason: Clearer rendering of 언데드로 동족상잔 than BASE’s calqued “as undead.”
SOL drops 안 그래도 (“anyway”) and replaces 자라나라 (“Grow”) with “Rise.”
“Could this be a bug?” is more spoken for 혹시 버그인가 than “Is this perhaps.”
The …… belongs on the following spoken line, not as a separate silent turn.
SOL’s “growing more modern” is better English, but 말했다 is “spoke,” not “answered.”
decisions.replacement: The Skeleton Warlord, growing more modern by the day, spoke in a dejected voice.

decisions.reason: 안으로 들어올수록 is first-person singular; SOL’s “we” is unsupported.
이 새끼는 is “this bastard,” not softened “this guy.”
“Reminding” plus “inward sigh” better matches being tired of repeating that he is already dead.
Tighter prose for the flushed shout and taking the familiar scene in stride, without changing the beat.
“Too” preserves 그것도, and “without losing a single person” matches 단 한 사람의 사망자도 없이.
SOL’s “only casualties” is cleaner, but “just” undercuts 이건 정말.
decisions.replacement: “Our only casualties are twenty-three seriously wounded and thirty lightly wounded. Ah, this is really…!”

decisions.reason: He is staring at Taekyung; “How do you manage this” is the natural addressee of 어떻게 매번 이럴 수 있는.
살짝 is “slightly,” not “mildly.”
왜요 is “Why?,” not “What?”
이럴 때는 is “when,” and “like that they were lucky” matches the modest claim; SOL’s “where/how” is looser.
More spoken for 정말 강해서 이런 걸 어떡합니까 without losing the meaning.
훌륭한 아부의 표본 is a “specimen of flattery”; SOL’s “shining example” flattens the joke.
“Banter” is the natural English for 주거니 받거니.
뭐지, 묘하게 is puzzled “somehow,” not a why-question.
“Ah, right” better fits 그렇지 않아도 than a generic “yes.”
SOL adds “as messengers” before the next sentence’s 전령 joke lands.
Cleaner English for the messenger/no-choice explanation without changing the facts.
“Them” supplies the omitted HQ subject of 한참 걸리겠군.
“Following behind us” is redundant; 뒤따라오는 is already “following us.”
피곤하겠지만 is concessive to the command (“you’re tired, but…”); SOL’s “they must be tired, but” botches that logic.
대형 is “large,” not “larger”; SOL’s “they” correctly makes the corpses the object of 옮기기.
decisions.replacement: “Shouldn’t we take care of the large monsters ourselves? They might be difficult for headquarters to move…”

decisions.reason: 움직이는 is “moving with us,” not “traveling.”
무찌르면…방식이었다 is a habitual method; SOL turns it into a one-off past sequence.
More direct for 굳이 청소라고 표현하는 이유 without adding meaning.
“Rise again as undead” is the natural equivalent of 언데드로 부활.
저어 is the hesitant “Um” before the awkward topic.
이런저런 말 is various talk/complaints; “grumbling” narrows it too early.
The echo is 말? 무슨 말?; “Grumbling?” is not closer.
BASE weakens 눈치 to a glance; both drop 속삭였다.
decisions.replacement: Shao Shen watched my expression and cautiously whispered.

decisions.reason: They share one assigned cleanup role; singular 역할 is more precise.
무슨 소리지 is “what is that supposed to mean,” not merely “what was he talking about.”
SOL drops 입술을 뗐다, recasts 설마 as dread, and moves 긴 onto the silence.
공 is merit, not glory; SOL’s “Is that it?” keeps 뭐 그런 거야.
decisions.replacement: “Do they want to stop cleaning up monster corpses and earn some merit themselves? Is that it?”

decisions.reason: This sentence does not call them 새끼들; SOL’s “assholes” intensifies the narration.
One-sentence 싶지만 structure is cleaner without changing the chink/Chinese distinction.
Preserves 착한 중국인의 대표; BASE flattens it to “model Chinese man.”
Closer to 전부는 아니고…것으로 알고 있습니다, including “as far as I know.”
한 가지 is “one thing,” which BASE weakens to “something.”
저 인간 is dismissive “guy,” not neutral “man.”
SOL drops 이곳을 향해 (“toward us/here”).
SOL cuts 앉아 있는 군용 차량 and upgrades 엉망이 된 to “ravaged.”
향하는 중이었다 is progressive heading, not inceptive “set out.”
정말 고생 is “really,” not the stiffer “truly.”
“Cinched”/“hide” is more vivid for 꽉 조인 벨트로도 감출 수 없는 뱃살.
눈앞의 is “in front of me”; SOL’s “sitting across” is unsupported.
Keep 안 그래도 and 승전보; close the quote so the footnote can move to the end.
decisions.replacement: “I contacted the higher-ups this morning, as it happens. The entire world, not to mention the United Nations Security Council, is in an uproar over Teacher Jin’s victory report! I don’t know what they mean, but apparently people in Korea are calling today Jumo’s death anniversary…”[^1]

decisions.reason: The footnote body should not interrupt the scene; it belongs at the chapter end.
Preserves 듣는 (“listening”) and 참지 못하고 as holding back from speaking.
Glossary requires 주모 as Jumo, not a substituted “tavern lady.”
“Included” and “encompassed” are equal for 속한; no gain.
바라봤다 is “looked,” not intensified “stared.”
왜, 왜 is repeated “why,” not a stuttered “Wh-Why.”
“On edge” is the natural English for 예민해졌네요.
Restores 아, 예, which BASE drops.
Same 알면서도/덤덤해진다 beat in less essay-like English.
Keeps the calm/polite 어조 without the redundant “I asked” before the quote.
More spoken rant for 지랄/막말로 without changing who fights or who waves the baton.
The rant lands more naturally; the corpse-fondness joke and 뒈져 봐야 threat stay intact.
“Gear them up” is natural for 장비 입혀서 in spoken threat, not a System-term swap.
입을 닫았다 is shutting his mouth, not the generic “fell silent.”
「…….」 is Liao’s spoken silence and should be quoted.
염병을 할 is “kicked up a fuss,” and 분명하다 is “clearly,” not weakened “apparently.”
“Out of your mind” is the idiomatic English for confrontational 제정신입니까.
SOL’s “accomplish something ourselves” over-specifies 뭔가를 보여 줘야 한다.
SOL changes 길 뚫고/뒷수습/잘하고 있는데 into generic clearing/aftermath/“everyone’s doing their job.”
어, 어허 is not a stutter, and 연배로 보나 계급으로 보나 is “whether by age or rank.”
대접 pun needs smashing the skull with a serving bowl; SOL’s “treat your skull to” loses 깨 버릴까.
SOL’s “misheard/get any foolish ideas” is more spoken, but 진격하자고요 is “let’s,” not “we advance.”
decisions.replacement: “Nothing. You misheard me. Anyway, I understand. Don’t get any foolish ideas. From now on, let’s advance slowly, minimize casualties, and rescue civilians. Understood?”

decisions.reason: 뒤룩뒤룩 굴리는 is shifty darting, not English eye-rolling.
연루되어…비리 건 is “implicated in a … case,” more precise than “involved in a scandal.”
SOL drops 황급히 and 앉아 있던 from the driver’s panic stop.
“Curled into himself… stammered out” is more vivid for 웅크린 채 벌벌 떨던…더듬거리는.
Liao’s “we were holding in reserve” is more natural for 예비대로 운용 중이던.
더 들을 필요도 없었다 belongs in the same beat as the roar, not a split paragraph.
어느새 가까워진 도시로부터 굉음이 울려 퍼졌 is a roar from a city that had drawn close, not a “looming” eruption.
End-note placement is correct, and the 주모 기일 gloss is needed for the joke to land.
